questions.question:
The sentences of a paragraph are given in a jumbled order.
A. There, in the fifteenth century, people began roasting the beans and brewing a drink from them.
B. Coffee began as a wild plant in the highlands of Ethiopia.
C. Today it is grown in dozens of countries and is among the most widely traded commodities in the world.
D. According to legend, a goatherd noticed that his goats became unusually lively after eating its red berries.
E. The drink soon spread through the Arab world and then to Europe, where coffee houses became centres of conversation and trade.
F. From Ethiopia the plant crossed the Red Sea and was first cultivated in Yemen.

Which of the following is the most logical order of the sentences?
questions.explanation: The correct order is BDFAEC. The first sentence introduces the topic (B), and each later sentence picks up the one before it through a link of time, reference or cause; C closes the paragraph.

questions.explanation: The correct order is CEAFDB. The first sentence introduces the topic (C), and each later sentence picks up the one before it through a link of time, reference or cause; B closes the paragraph.

The sentences of a paragraph are given in a jumbled order.
A. Early number systems used a blank space to mark an empty place, which often caused confusion.

C. The idea of zero is so familiar today that it is easy to forget it had to be invented.
D. Modern arithmetic and computing both rest on that single step.
E. Indian mathematicians gave the empty place a symbol and, more importantly, treated it as a number in its own right.
F. They also worked out rules for adding, subtracting and multiplying with it.

questions.explanation: The correct order is CAEFBD. The first sentence introduces the topic (C), and each later sentence picks up the one before it through a link of time, reference or cause; D closes the paragraph.
